newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse prices mixed, focus on first tier.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse prices mixed, focus on first tier.

text.p: Bucharest share prices tracked sideways on Wednesday, when two first tier stocks dominated trading, accounting for the bulk of turnover.
Nine stocks touched new highs, 10 slid and two were unchanged. Six stocks had no trade and two companies remained suspended pending announcements on shareholders' meetings.

Two independent indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- rose from the previous session by 2.3 and 0.99 percent respectively at 533 and 543.71 points. The BIG first-tier index was 1,764.30 points, 1.0 percent up on the previous session.

First-tier Azomures fertiliser maker had 2.3 billion lei in turnover, with more than half coming from a special trade -- a deal struck outside the market and reported to the bourse later. The deal involved 1.0 million shares, traded at a total 1.74 billion lei.
Chemical plant Oltchim took 2.2 billion lei of overall turnover and ended slightly down at 1,430 lei.
"I expect buyers will stick to these two companies for many future sessions and I see volumes starting to rise also in the other first-tier company," said a trader.
Terapia pharmaceuticals maker moved to the first tier on Tuesday. On Wednesday, it had 88 million lei in turnover and closed 50 lei higher at 2,800.
"It remains the most expensive share on the market, if compared with its nominal price, but holders are not willing to sell at lower prices," a broker said.
Policolor dye maker was the most active on the second tier, with 422 million lei in turnover and a closing quote 40 lei firmer at 1,830.
